title: Newspaper Article 2: Nighttime Visibility
claims: Almost fifty percent of all pedestrian fatalities occur between 6:00 p.m. and midnight, according to NHTSA data cited by FHWA.
In the cited material, eight out of ten drivers who struck people at night reported not seeing them.
A pedestrian in dark clothing at night may first be seen about 55 feet away, giving the driver little time to react.
